evidence_summary: Wintermute's official site describes proprietary high-frequency algorithms and quantitative strategies, institutional OTC liquidity for spot and derivatives, Wintermute Node with direct liquidity access and execution, and liquidity provision/market-making for tokens. Its DeFi page markets Wintermute as operating across DeFi, providing liquidity on major chains and supporting DEX types including AMMs and RFQ/P2P liquidity. Wintermute Ventures is described as investing its own/proprietary funds, with no evidence of a sub-fund, feeder, umbrella, parallel fund, SPV, fund platform, or fund-of-funds structure.
yes_boundaries: otc_trading crosses the threshold because Wintermute explicitly markets an OTC desk/platform and OTC spot/derivatives liquidity.
algorithm_trading crosses the threshold because Wintermute explicitly describes proprietary high-frequency algorithms and quantitative strategies.
market_making crosses the threshold because Wintermute explicitly provides liquidity and identifies market-making/liquidity provision as a core business.
execution_services crosses the threshold because Wintermute Node/API provide direct liquidity access and reliable/click-to-trade/electronic execution.
defi crosses the threshold because Wintermute itself markets DeFi operations, including liquidity across major chains, DEX support, governance contribution, and DeFi research/building.
no_boundaries: Wintermute Ventures' DeFi startup investing alone was not used to infer DeFi capability; the yes decision relies on Wintermute's own DeFi liquidity/governance/research operations.
Wintermute Ventures says it invests own/proprietary funds, but that is not explicit evidence of a sub-fund, feeder, umbrella, parallel fund, SPV, fund platform, or fund-of-funds.
